headline: Devils’ Anthony Mantha to ‘miss some time’ with throat injury
take:
Anthony Mantha will "miss some time" with a throat injury, per Daily Faceoff, and the Devils went 11 forwards and seven defensemen in Toronto on Sunday. They won 4-0 anyway, their fifth straight.

Mantha has been a useful depth piece: 10 points in 17 games in about 13:30 a night, after 33 goals for Pittsburgh last season. The interesting part is that he has been unlucky on the ice. New Jersey has taken about 58% of the five-on-five expected goals with him out there, but scored nearly seven fewer goals than those chances usually bring. That kind of gap tends to close, so the Devils lose a player whose results were about to catch up with his play.

At 13-5-0, with 59% of the expected goals in its games, New Jersey can cover a bottom-six hole. The bigger question this week is in net, not on the wing.
